preconditions.description: The tree has exactly n vertices, where n is between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The next n-1 lines each contain exactly two integers x_i and y_i, representing edges of the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(set().union(*[set(line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n]])) == n
preconditions.description: The edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree) with exactly n vertices.

postconditions.description: The final output is a single line '! r' where r is the root vertex of the tree (hotel location).

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('?') for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '! r')
postconditions.description: All non-final lines are queries of the form '? u v' to find the LCA of vertices u and v.

postconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('?')]) <= n // 2
postconditions.description: The total number of queries does not exceed ⌊n/2⌋.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('?') for u, v in [line.split()[1:]])
postconditions.description: Each query '? u v' contains two valid vertices u and v within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all('! r' not in line for line in stdout.splitlines()[:-1])
postconditions.description: The final answer '! r' appears exactly once and is the last line of output.
